text:
anil: quick ping — opened PR #3921 to change the KV eviction TTL default from 60m -> 15m to reduce memory tail on hot shards. can someone run a short staging smoke and eyeball eviction logs? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3921

mira: grabbing this now, will run 20m smoke against the kv-hot pool. do you want the standard hot-tail profile or the long-seq run?

anil: hot-tail is fine — short seq, high key churn. sample command: 
```
./tools/loadgen --mode hot-tail --keys 30k --qps 250 --seq 64 --duration 00:20:00
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=kv-hot -o wide
kubectl logs -n runtime -l app=kv-hot --tail=200 | grep eviction
```
check pod RSS, GC pauses, and eviction timestamps. if everything looks sane, we can merge and roll a small canary.

jamie: I can code-review in ~90m. quick skim looks fine but there's a tiny kernel-path touch in the allocator dir — will comment inline.

deploy-bot: pipeline: PR#3921 CI queued -> started -> unit-tests passed, integration-suite running. build: 9c4d1a

mira: smoke done. memory on kv-hot pods dropped ~18% median, no OOMs. eviction rate increased briefly at t+3m then stabilized. attached short log excerpt: https://staging-logs.redwood.ai/3921/evict-snippet.txt  :thumbsup:

anil: great, thanks @mira. @jamie ping for the kernel-path nit and the TTL var name. plan is to merge by 18:30 PST and kick a 5% canary for 30m.

jamie: left one inline suggestion: rename `ttl_seconds` to `kv_default_ttl_s` for clarity (there are several TTLs in other modules). also asked to add a tiny unit-test that verifies default value is applied when config absent. otherwise LGTM pending green CI.

lucy: fyi for product/console: this will increase eviction churn for customers who relied on implicit long TTLs. please add a short note to the console changelog and mark as 'operational change, non-breaking'.

anil: will make the rename + test + changelog. thanks all — unless objections I'll merge at 18:30 PST and start the canary.
